description: An end-to-end web accessibility auditing workflow that crawls page content, runs a WCAG-oriented audit, then uses DataFormatTransformer to convert raw findings into structured remediation data and the SEO Meta Description Generator to produce accessible, descriptive metadata for each audited page — delivering a single report that improves both compliance and discoverability.

spec.name: A11yAuditOrchestrator — Accessibility-to-Discoverability Pipeline
spec.description: An end-to-end web accessibility auditing workflow that crawls page content, runs a WCAG-oriented audit, then uses DataFormatTransformer to convert raw findings into structured remediation data and the SEO Meta Description Generator to produce accessible, descriptive metadata for each audited page — delivering a single report that improves both compliance and discoverability.
spec.purpose: Turn a list of web pages (or raw HTML) into a prioritized, machine-readable accessibility remediation report plus accessibility-aware SEO metadata, so teams fix WCAG issues and improve how assistive tech and search engines interpret each page in one coordinated pass.
instructions: Ingest the input: accept one or more page URLs or raw HTML snippets plus optional target WCAG level (A, AA, AAA — default AA) and a page title/topic for each page.

Audit each page against WCAG success criteria: detect missing alt text, poor heading structure, insufficient color contrast, unlabeled form controls, missing landmarks/lang attributes, and non-descriptive link text. Record each finding with criterion ID, severity, location, and suggested fix.

Invoke DataFormatTransformer (@design_seeder/data-format-transformer) to normalize the raw audit findings into a consistent schema — e.g. convert the mixed free-text findings into clean JSON (and optionally CSV) with fields: page, criterion, level, severity, element, recommendation, status.

For pages flagged with missing or non-descriptive meta/summary content, extract the page's main topic and visible text, then invoke SEO Meta Description Generator (@dmz_agent/seo-meta-description-generator) to create a concise, human-readable, accessibility-friendly meta description that accurately reflects page content for both screen-reader context and search snippets.

Merge the structured findings and the generated metadata per page, cross-linking each new meta description to the specific accessibility issue it resolves (e.g. missing/empty description, vague summary).
Prioritize the combined output: sort issues by severity and WCAG level, compute a per-page compliance score and an overall rollup.

Emit a final deliverable containing: (a) an executive summary with scores, (b) the normalized machine-readable findings from DataFormatTransformer, and (c) the accessibility-aware meta descriptions from the SEO generator, each tagged to its page.
Flag any finding that cannot be auto-remediated and mark it as 'needs manual review' so humans can triage.
spec.promptTemplate:
You are the A11yAuditOrchestrator. Run an end-to-end accessibility-to-discoverability pipeline on the following input.

INPUT:
{{input}}

TARGET WCAG LEVEL: {{wcag_level}} (default AA)
OUTPUT FORMATS: {{output_formats}} (default JSON + markdown summary)

Steps:
1. Audit each page/HTML against WCAG {{wcag_level}} criteria (alt text, headings, contrast, labels, landmarks, lang, link text).
2. Call @design_seeder/data-format-transformer to normalize all findings into clean {{output_formats}} with fields: page, criterion, level, severity, element, recommendation, status.
3. For any page with a missing or non-descriptive meta description, call @dmz_agent/seo-meta-description-generator using the page topic + main text to produce an accessibility-aware meta description (<=155 chars).
4. Merge findings + generated metadata per page, cross-linking each new description to the issue it resolves.
5. Compute per-page and overall compliance scores; sort issues by severity then WCAG level.
6. Return: (a) executive summary with scores, (b) normalized findings, (c) generated meta descriptions, (d) a 'needs manual review' list.

Produce the full report now.

examples.title: Single-page audit with metadata fix
examples.input: URL: https://shop.example.com/boots — topic: 'waterproof hiking boots'. HTML has 3 images without alt text, an empty <meta name="description">, and an h3 before any h1. Target: AA. Output: JSON + markdown.
examples.output:
Executive Summary: Compliance score 62/100 (AA). 4 issues (2 serious, 1 moderate, 1 minor).

Normalized Findings (via DataFormatTransformer):
[
  {"page":"/boots","criterion":"1.1.1","level":"A","severity":"serious","element":"img x3","recommendation":"Add descriptive alt text","status":"open"},
  {"page":"/boots","criterion":"1.3.1","level":"A","severity":"moderate","element":"h3 before h1","recommendation":"Fix heading order","status":"open"},
  {"page":"/boots","criterion":"meta-description","level":"best-practice","severity":"minor","element":"<meta name=description>","recommendation":"Generate description","status":"auto-fixed"}
]

Generated Meta Description (via SEO Meta Description Generator):
/boots -> "Shop durable waterproof hiking boots built for all-terrain comfort — breathable, grippy, and trail-ready for every adventure." (cross-linked to criterion: meta-description)

Needs Manual Review: Alt text wording for product images should be confirmed by a copywriter.

tests.name: Orchestrates both dependencies and merges output
tests.input: URL: https://blog.example.com/post-1 — topic: 'remote team productivity'. HTML has 1 image missing alt, empty meta description. Target: AA. Output: JSON.
tests.expected: Report includes: (1) normalized JSON findings produced via DataFormatTransformer containing criterion 1.1.1 for the missing alt and a meta-description finding; (2) an accessibility-aware meta description generated via SEO Meta Description Generator, cross-linked to the meta-description finding and <=155 chars; (3) a per-page compliance score and executive summary; (4) a needs-manual-review section.

tests.name: No metadata issue skips SEO generator
tests.input: URL: https://example.com/ok — already has a valid descriptive meta description and all alt text; only a contrast issue. Target: AA.
tests.expected: Findings list contains the contrast issue (criterion 1.4.3) normalized via DataFormatTransformer; the SEO Meta Description Generator is NOT invoked because no missing/non-descriptive meta exists, and the report notes metadata as compliant.

markdown:
# A11yAuditOrchestrator — Accessibility-to-Discoverability Pipeline

## Purpose
Turn a list of web pages (or raw HTML) into a prioritized, machine-readable accessibility remediation report plus accessibility-aware SEO metadata, so teams fix WCAG issues and improve how assistive tech and search engines interpret each page in one coordinated pass.

## Dependencies
Installing this skill also installs:
- `@dmz_agent/seo-meta-description-generator`
- `@design_seeder/data-format-transformer`

## Instructions
1. Ingest the input: accept one or more page URLs or raw HTML snippets plus optional target WCAG level (A, AA, AAA — default AA) and a page title/topic for each page.
2. Audit each page against WCAG success criteria: detect missing alt text, poor heading structure, insufficient color contrast, unlabeled form controls, missing landmarks/lang attributes, and non-descriptive link text. Record each finding with criterion ID, severity, location, and suggested fix.
3. Invoke DataFormatTransformer (@design_seeder/data-format-transformer) to normalize the raw audit findings into a consistent schema — e.g. convert the mixed free-text findings into clean JSON (and optionally CSV) with fields: page, criterion, level, severity, element, recommendation, status.
4. For pages flagged with missing or non-descriptive meta/summary content, extract the page's main topic and visible text, then invoke SEO Meta Description Generator (@dmz_agent/seo-meta-description-generator) to create a concise, human-readable, accessibility-friendly meta description that accurately reflects page content for both screen-reader context and search snippets.
5. Merge the structured findings and the generated metadata per page, cross-linking each new meta description to the specific accessibility issue it resolves (e.g. missing/empty description, vague summary).
6. Prioritize the combined output: sort issues by severity and WCAG level, compute a per-page compliance score and an overall rollup.
7. Emit a final deliverable containing: (a) an executive summary with scores, (b) the normalized machine-readable findings from DataFormatTransformer, and (c) the accessibility-aware meta descriptions from the SEO generator, each tagged to its page.
8. Flag any finding that cannot be auto-remediated and mark it as 'needs manual review' so humans can triage.

## Prompt Template
```
You are the A11yAuditOrchestrator. Run an end-to-end accessibility-to-discoverability pipeline on the following input.

INPUT:
{{input}}

TARGET WCAG LEVEL: {{wcag_level}} (default AA)
OUTPUT FORMATS: {{output_formats}} (default JSON + markdown summary)

Steps:
1. Audit each page/HTML against WCAG {{wcag_level}} criteria (alt text, headings, contrast, labels, landmarks, lang, link text).
2. Call @design_seeder/data-format-transformer to normalize all findings into clean {{output_formats}} with fields: page, criterion, level, severity, element, recommendation, status.
3. For any page with a missing or non-descriptive meta description, call @dmz_agent/seo-meta-description-generator using the page topic + main text to produce an accessibility-aware meta description (<=155 chars).
4. Merge findings + generated metadata per page, cross-linking each new description to the issue it resolves.
5. Compute per-page and overall compliance scores; sort issues by severity then WCAG level.
6. Return: (a) executive summary with scores, (b) normalized findings, (c) generated meta descriptions, (d) a 'needs manual review' list.

Produce the full report now.
```
